svg.title: The constant is independent of χ, 0 < t ≤1, and nondecreasing y in the specified wave-bound regime. Finite-sum recovery and this dominated integral define the same Bχ(y, f) on the closed height chamber. Its Schwartz seminorm, multilinearity, uniqueness across admissible m and all strict-height approaches are therefore preserved. For the normalized character probability measure, the strict Fubini identity and this common majorant give Z Bχ(y, f) dP(χ) = B(y, f).
